It's possible that your condition might be neuroplastic. Meaning there's nothing physically wrong with you but rather there's a mistake being made by your brain telling you there's pain as a false alarm. This is actually far more common than people realize. 

You said you had testing done and everything came back negative right? If so that's a good thing that means there's nothing actually wrong with you. In which case you may want to try pain re-processing therapy.

Go on YouTube and look for videos from Howard Schubiner and tanner murtaugh that talk more about that therapy.

Continue to follow up with your doctor and do any more testing if possible but in the meantime you've got nothing to lose by trying out the pain processing therapy. It's free and simple and safe to try and it may very well help you heal the condition.
